clips.title: The story
paras: In Thousand Needles, the Tattered Manuscript lies hidden in Splithoof Hold. Its torn pages came from the Tome of the Cabal, and warlocks seek them to learn how to summon a felhunter.

The Tome of the Cabal was once a unique, intact volume kept in the fallen kingdom of Lordaeron. An unknown defiler tore almost half its pages from the binding. The remaining spine and pages became known as the Moldy Tome. They were sent south toward Khaz Modan, then lost at sea. The torn leaves crossed the Great Sea to Kalimdor and came into the hands of the Galak centaur inside Splithoof Hold.

The manuscript rests in a battered chest deep in the caverns of Splithoof Hold, where it endured the dry winds of Thousand Needles. Alliance warlocks work with Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge, while Horde practitioners aid Jorah Annison in the Undercity. Both groups brave the aggressive centaur to reunite the leaves with the Moldy Tome. Together, the books hold the dark rituals for summoning and binding a demonic felhunter.
